notes.title: Check out the new trailer!
notes.notes:
Get ready for an adrenaline rush! The latest trailer is packed with explosive new upgrades from our brand-new demo:

* Weaponized Mayhem: Lock and load with a devastating new arsenal – from the hard-hitting "Beer Blaster" to the flashy "Cocktail Uzi" and the elegant "Lady Cricket" – find your perfect fit!
* Smooth as Butter Gunplay: Experience even smoother and more realistic firing and reloading animations – every shot packs a punch!
* Killer Soundtrack & Voiceovers: Immerse yourself in the action with a completely revamped soundtrack and audio experience!
* Revamped Battlegrounds: Explore completely redesigned levels that will force you to adapt and master new tactics!

Craving fast-paced, non-stop action? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/690210/Roboholic/]Sign up for our playtest[/url] to be among the first to experience our new first-person shooter roguelike demo!

[previewyoutube=fQcoZCx6hpo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Introductory video, revealing the "Roboholic" universe to you.
notes.notes:
Once upon a time on Earth, an inexplicable epidemic erupted — the cocoa fungus. The leading chocolate bar manufacturer, "CHOCO," found this mysterious virus alarming and deployed all its resources in search of a cure. Unfortunately, the search was in vain. So, "CHOCO" resolved to move the cocoa plantations and factories to the planet Folly.

Everything was proceeding well: cocoa trees were thriving on the new planet, chocolate bars were being produced, and sent to all chocolate lovers. Until one horrific day, all the robots went berserk.

Thank you for staying with us!

[previewyoutube=P3kjg3CbjJ0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Official Trailer for "Roboholic"
notes.notes:
Hey there, dear friends! We're excited to present to you our latest trailer, designed to give you a deeper look into the thrilling world of robo-adventures and provide more information about our game.

Since the announcement of "Roboholic," our team has been hard at work improving graphics, gameplay, balance, and optimization to ensure you have an unforgettable gaming experience filled with joy.

Check out the new trailer to witness incredible battles, mysterious locations, a variety of possibilities, and a whole lot of fun. Dive into the world of robots, insane physics, and epic adventures!

Stay tuned for updates and all the juicy details. We'll keep you in the loop!

[previewyoutube=RXLYOMQ1UM8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Open playtest!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

We are excited to announce that we will be conducting a remote playtest for Roboholic! 

We are looking for participants who are interested in providing feedback on our game before its official release. Your feedback will help us improve the quality of our game and make it more enjoyable.

Here are the details of the playtest:

We will arrange a date and time with you. We can find time slots at almost any time.
You must have Discord and be ready to share your screen.
The playtest will last 1 hour.

What to Expect:

You will be playing our game for approximately 1 hour.
After and through the gameplay session, we will ask you to provide feedback on your experience.
We will also be recording your gameplay session for internal use only.

How to Sign Up:

Write to [b]dormi110195@gmail.com[/b] with the title: Roboholic Playtest 

Thank you!
